entities.name: Grand Duke Kirill Vladimirovich of Russia

entities.summary: Grand Duke Kirill Vladimirovich of Russia was a Russian grand duke and a claimant to the defunct Russian throne from 1924 until his death. He was the son of Grand Duke Vladimir Alexandrovich of Russia and a grandson of Emperor Alexander II.
